name: Amassoma

queries.query: Amassoma Nigeria official cadastral parcel map GIS Bayelsa State Ministry of Lands BGIS
queries.result: First-party discovery identified the official Bayelsa Geographic Information System (BGIS) and the Bayelsa State Ministry of Lands and Survey. BGIS describes digital land-record management and a computerized database of land titles, survey plans, and property documents, but discovery did not expose a public parcel viewer/API endpoint for anonymous bounded geometry retrieval.

queries.query: Amassoma Ijaw GIS cadastral parcel map Bayelsa
queries.result: A separate local-language-oriented discovery attempt was run using the local Ijaw/Izon identity of Southern Ijaw/Amassoma. It returned place/map references and the same official BGIS lead, but no official Ijaw-language cadastral endpoint or public parcel geometry service. English is the operating language of the official Bayelsa sites inspected.
